dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetric geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth convex margins with a minor localized indentation on the anterior-left lateral boundary.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey skin tone with consistent median pixel intensity across the dorsal field.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey mottling distributed across the central and posterior dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; low-contrast gradient transitions between localized pigment variations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear high-contrast markings (rake scars) visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent central longitudinal ridge along the axial midline creating a localized shadow-cast on the left-facing slope.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of healed linear rake marks concentrated on the posterior dorsal plane.
